title: Position Words: Above, Below, In Front, Behind
seo_title: Position and Direction – Kindergarten Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Use position words: above, below, on, under, in, next to, between, in front of, behind, left and right. (summary of the NERDC Kindergarten Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free kindergarten maths worksheets for Nigeria: above and below, in and on, next to and between, in front and behind, left and right. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_sub: Use words like above, under and next to.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Above means higher. Below means lower.
  • Between means in the middle of two things.
  • Your left hand and your right hand help you with left and right.

Examples

Example

The cat is under the table. Is the cat above or below the table?

Under means lower

Answer: Below

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Mixing up left and rightHold up your left hand: it makes an L.
Mixing up in and onIn is inside. On is on top.
Forgetting betweenBetween needs two things, one on each side.

items.q: What shape is above the square?

items.q: What shape is between the triangle and the square?

items.q: What shape is next to the triangle at the end?

items.q: Which shape is next to both other shapes?
items.e: The circle is in the middle, so it is next to both. The answer is circle.

items.q: What shape is at the other end from the square?
